about_the_game:
Get ready to hit the tracks in the Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown demo! Experience fast-paced, chaotic racing with friends through LAN multiplayer and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the competition.

What’s in the Demo?

  • LAN Multiplayer: Race with your friends and battle it out to claim the title of Galactic Champion.

  • Three Unique Cars: Each vehicle has its own signature skill, giving you a strategic edge on the track.

    • KUNTASH: Jump upwards and glide through the air, defying gravity.

    • Shell - B: Plow through obstacles and opponents like an unstoppable force.

    • BAE - 86: Transform into a miniature car to dodge attacks or maneuver tight spaces. Cancel the transformation at any time!

  • Secondary Skills: Customize your strategy by choosing from these epic abilities:

    • Cosmic Stomp: Slam the ground to create a shockwave that launches nearby cars into the air.

    • Fissure: Fire a forcefield that travels straight ahead, tossing any car in its path skyward.

    • Cosmic Swap: Target the car in front and swap positions after 2 seconds, catching your opponent off guard.

  • One Circuit Track: Show off your driving skills and put your strategies to the test on a dynamic circuit that challenges your reflexes and precision.

Why Play the Demo?

Get a taste of the chaotic fun and adrenaline-pumping action that Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown has to offer. Whether you’re racing to the finish or unleashing cosmic chaos on your rivals, this demo will leave you craving more!

Download the demo now and prove your skills on the track!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 with 2.8 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce® GTX™ 560 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 with 3.0 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX™ 970 or AMD Radeon™ R9 380X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible

short_description: A high-speed arcade racing game where you battle rivals using unique car abilities and strategic power-ups. Drift, boost, and unleash cosmic chaos in intense LAN multiplayer races on a dynamic circuit track.
